title: chrysosplenium alternifolium f. iowense
intro: Chrysosplenium alternifolium f. iowense, commonly known as an Iowa Yellow-spike Wintergreen, is a flowering plant species within the family Saxifragaceae. It is used for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for wound healing and skin conditions.
